workspace.resizeHelp: Drag to resize; use arrow keys for 20 px steps, Home/End for limits.
workspace.dockingHelp: Moves the same conversation. Drafts, attachments and active responses stay intact.
workspace.monitorHelp: One shared telemetry feed. Compact: 5 s; expanded: 1 s. Hidden app pauses UI polling.
workspace.resetHelp: Restores panel placement and sizes only. Keeps work, conversations and generation settings.
workspace.noSample: Telemetry unavailable or awaiting a sample
workspace.collapseHelp: Moves the same conversation. Drafts, attachments and active responses stay intact.
workspace.conversationsHelp: Show or hide saved conversations without changing the active chat.
